settings.tagline: Escape Into Nature. Stay Close to Serenity.
settings.address: Mamudi, Murguma, Purulia, West Bengal 723152, India
settings.heroSubheading: Experience the beauty of nature and a relaxing stay at Hill Queen Eco Resort, Murguma, Purulia.
settings.aboutText: Nestled in the tranquil valley of Mamudi near the scenic Murguma Dam in Purulia, West Bengal, Hill Queen Eco Resort is a peaceful nature retreat designed for travellers seeking rest, clean mountain air, and authentic hospitality. Surrounded by the rolling ridges of the Ajodhya Hills and lush rural landscape, our eco-friendly resort offers comfortable cottage accommodations, home-cooked regional meals, and personalized care. Whether you are seeking a peaceful weekend get-away with family, exploring the hills, or unwinding by the lake, Hill Queen Eco Resort welcomes you to a serene home away from home.
settings.seoTitle: Hill Queen Eco Resort | Luxury Nature Resort in Murguma, Purulia
settings.seoDescription: Experience peaceful luxury at Hill Queen Eco Resort in Mamudi, Murguma, Purulia, West Bengal 723152. Serene accommodation near Murguma Dam & Ajodhya Hills with authentic hospitality.

rooms.name: Eco Lake View Cottage
rooms.description: Spacious independent cottage featuring panoramic views of the scenic countryside and gentle breezes from nearby Murguma Dam. Crafted with warm rustic touches, a private veranda, and comfortable double bedding for restful sleep.
rooms.foodInclusion: Complimentary morning tea; fresh home-cooked meals available on order
rooms.amenities: Attached Western Bathroom, 24/7 Running Water, Private Veranda, Mountain View, Power Backup, Tea Maker

rooms.name: Deluxe Hillside Family Cottage
rooms.description: Designed specifically for family vacations and group retreats exploring the Purulia hills. Features spacious double bedding, ample luggage area, natural ventilation, and an attached modern washroom.
rooms.foodInclusion: Complimentary morning tea; hearty thali lunches & dinners prepared fresh
rooms.amenities: Attached Western Bathroom, Hot Water Facility, Garden View, Outdoor Seating, Campfire Area Access, Room Service

rooms.name: Standard Serenity Room
rooms.description: Comfortable, quiet and budget-conscious nature lodging for solo travellers, couples, or nature photographers. Enjoy cool hill breezes, pure village silence, and immediate access to scenic walking paths.
rooms.foodInclusion: Complimentary morning tea; on-site dining available
rooms.amenities: Attached Western Bathroom, Clean Linens, Ceiling Fan, Serene Green View, Secure Vehicle Parking
